vadsrijk.z2.systemen.adv3.klaar: ✦ Level 30! You're ready for your third job advancement to %s! Go to the Crystal Chapel in Sugarbowl or the order temple in Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.gehaald: Carefully popped out (%s). Your crystal is back in your bag.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.gezet: Click! The crystal is in: %s sparkles.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.kies: Pick something with sockets on the left. Then I'll set a crystal in it!
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.kies_krist: Pick a crystal on the left first.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.te_weinig: Removing costs %s. You don't have that yet.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.uitleg: Setting is free. Removing costs a few coins, and you always get your crystal back.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.juwelier.weg: That's no longer in your bag.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.kristal.ijsglans.ef: %s%% chance that what you hit becomes Frozen
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.kristal.uitleg: The jewelerguh in Sugarbowl sets this in a socket of your gear.
vadsrijk.z2.systemen.tip.adv3: At level 30 your final ceremony awaits: a new title and a new power. In the Crystal Chapel of Sugarbowl or in the order temple.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.afgekoeld: The drill heads have cooled down. The panel picks a new order...
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.cliff: Pfff! This isn't over yet! In the fort the Overdrill is waiting... and it drills through EVERYTHING! Nyeh-heh-heh!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.cliff2: That crystal was for the Fingers! The Emperor doesn't like to w... FORGET I SAID THAT!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.cliff_onder: The Mika Drill Master drives back to the fort in a cloud of smoke
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.fase3.onder: The machine creaks at every seam
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.fout: WRONG ORDER! Steam! All drill heads cool down.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.koud: The armor is ice-cold and sealed. The machine is asleep.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.mijnwerkers: Mika Miners are climbing out of the shaft!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.slot: The drilling machine is locked. There's a red button with a little cheese on it... you don't know yet how to switch it on.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.smelt.onder: His armor is melting: strike now!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.bm.steenregen: Rock rain! Out of the red circles!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.boormeester.onder: Drills everything to bits. Even the coziness.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.burcht.gang: The Splinter Hall! Dodge the red shard lanes and beat all the waves.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.burcht.gang_klaar: The Splinter Hall is quiet. The gate to the great hall opens...
vadsrijk.z2bazen.burcht.open: The crystal locks glow... the crystal gate dissolves into light!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.galmwolf.onder: Whose howl makes the mountains crack
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.beschut: The pillar catches the echo... and cracks.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.fase2.onder: He calls up new pillars and his cubs
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.fase3.onder: A snowstorm. Listen for the echo!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.galm: The Echo Wolf starts a CRYSTAL ECHO! Hide behind a frozen pillar, or interrupt him!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.onderbroken: Interrupted! The Echo Wolf chokes on his own howl.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.roep: The Echo Wolf calls the ice: new pillars shoot up at the purple circles!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.gw.verslagen: The Echo Wolf shatters into gray shards that melt away in the snow.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.fase2.onder: Only what stands in the light casts a shadow
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.mis: Miss! That was a reflection... it strikes back.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.regen: Shard rain on %s! Stand TOGETHER in the yellow circle.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.split: Lady Mirrorsigh splits into reflections! Only she has NO shadow.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.straal: A crystal eye is charging a mirror beam! Turn the mirrors (right-click) so it hits HER. Out of the purple line!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.verblind: The beam bounces straight into her face! Lady Mirrorsigh is blinded!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.sz.verslagen: Lady Mirrorsigh breaks into a thousand gray shards. The light in the hall turns warm and pink.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.te_ver: You're outside the fight: you can't hit it from there!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.astrolabiumwachter: Strike mostly when the rings line up (golden light): then your hit lands in full. During a Ring Sweep: stand in a pink gap.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.boormeester: Hit the drill heads until they overheat, in the order shown on the panel. Wrong order = steam!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.boormeester_paneel: Watch and listen: the panel lights up the drill heads one by one. Low = red, middle = yellow, high = blue.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.boormeester_pantser: You can't do much to the machine itself. Make the drill heads overheat in the right order: then its armor melts.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.donderbuik: Pink circles = cloud cushions. Stand on one when he starts sucking, or he'll pull you to his belly.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.galmwolf: Purple across the whole arena = Crystal Echo: stand BEHIND a frozen pillar (or hit him hard enough to interrupt). Each pillar only holds two echoes.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.glimmertje: He snuffs out the fire bowls. Right-click a dark bowl 2x to light it again. All four out? Then he hides in the dark.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.gorgonzola: He shuts the warm-air valves. Right-click a closed valve 3x to turn it open again.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.grauwe_droom: You are inside Mother Cloudwhale's dream. Gray tendrils? Smash them: each tendril makes the dream tougher and holds you tight.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.ringeling: Raid tip: JUMP into the pink circle to catch a kicking ring. In the dark: grab star shards and bring them to the beacons. Low ring = jump, high ring = sneak.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.spiegel: Right-click turns the mirror: / , \ or flat (then the light goes straight through).
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.spiegelvizier: Raid tip: only the real Mirror Vizier sparkles now and then. Turn (right-click) two mirrors to the same image to unmask him.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.spiegelzucht: Reflections: only she has NO shadow. Mirror beam: turn the mirrors so the purple beam hits her. Yellow = stand together!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.splinterzaal: Red lanes = shards flying across the corridor. Step out before the lane fills up!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.ster_bultguh: Raid tip: the Humpguh charges along a red lane: step out of it.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.ster_pluis: Raid tip: the Little Fluff heals the others: interrupt her song.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.sterrenbeelden: Raid tip: the three constellations must go down within 10 seconds of each other. Get all three low first, and interrupt the Fluff's Star Song!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.sterrenguh: Right-click the four telescopes until they all point at its heart (golden beam). Then it glows: double damage!
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.wormelien: Keep moving when she dives under (standing still = sand fountain). Pink spots = hide behind a dune. Phase 3: knock the gray salt crust off her back, jump from a dune or shoot it off.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.zandwachter: Raid tip: the Sand Warden only really takes damage once the hourglass has been flipped. Two groups on the two pink plates, at the same time! Then: hit him in the BACK.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.zilverstaart: Five Cloud Watchers? One of them is him: look for the SILVER glint by the tail. Hitting a decoy costs you some Chonk.
vadsrijk.z2bazen.tip.zoutkolos: Red crack lines = salt waves. Hear a high note? Step out of the purple ring around a crystal, or smash it. Phase 3: look straight at his glowing heart for double damage.
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.alle: All five drill tracks point to the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, all the way in the west. The drill hall is open!
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.boorgaten: On the avalanche path there are round holes in the snow, neatly in a row. Something has been test drilling here. They lead north, to the gorge.
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.boorschema: Behind Inventor Cogwheel's workshop lies a cheese sandwich with a note: 'Drill hall west: secret crack. Password: meow. Do NOT tell the guhs.'
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.bouwtekening: A drawing of a machine with three drill heads: left, middle, right. Scribbled underneath: 'They get hot in the order they start glowing. Watch the little light!'
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.olievlek: By the big drill tower there's a puddle of black oil. Little paw prints run through it. Four toes and a little pad. And a receipt: 'Drill head 2: do NOT overheat!'
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.teller: Drill tracks found: %s of %s. Inventor Cogwheel will want to know about this!
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.titel.boorsche: A Drill Plan in the Wastebasket
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.titel.olievlek: An Oil Stain with Cat Paws
vadsrijk.z2npc.aanwijzing.warme_spleet: At the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, all the way in the west, warm air blows out of a crack. You hear humming. And very softly... a cheese tooter. Something is hidden here.
vadsrijk.z2npc.chocomelk: Here you go, a warm mug of hot cocoa. With a marshmallow. Well, two.
vadsrijk.z2npc.chocomelk.al: You just had one! Finish it first, then you get another.
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.splinter.0: On the mountain pass lies something enormous. Gray feathers, fluffy wings, little ears like horns. Wahoognir.
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.splinter.1: He's hurt. A big gray crystal splinter sticks out of his wing. Around him, the snow is gray.
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.splinter.2: He sees you. He doesn't growl. He just sighs. Very deeply.
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.splinter.optie: Very carefully pull the splinter out
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.splinter.vraag: A gray crystal splinter is stuck in his wing. He's breathing heavily. He looks at you, but he doesn't move.
vadsrijk.z2npc.draak.weg: Wahoognir gives you a long look. For a moment you see something pink in his eyes. Then he spreads his wings and flies away.
vadsrijk.z2npc.gondel.omhoog: All aboard! The gondola is going up. No wobbling. Okay, a little wobbling.
vadsrijk.z2npc.juwelier.later: My socket bench is still in the works (it comes with the zone 2 systems). Come back later!
vadsrijk.z2npc.luchtschip.te_laag: Brrr. The Splinter Peaks are freezing and dangerous, adventurer. Come back when you're level 20. (now level %s)
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.aankomst: Welcome to Sugarbowl! Café Owner Mallow is waiting with hot cocoa in the café on the square.
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.einde.onder: Far in the east, beyond the clouds, stands a tree as big as a mountain.
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.flashback.onder: Wahoognir, the pink guardian dragon of the Chonkdom
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.naald: The spire cracks! The ship glides into the warm geode just in time.
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.storm: A snowstorm! Ice floes slam against the hull!
vadsrijk.z2npc.scene.wolf: On a crystal spire stands a wolf of gray crystal. It howls.
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.burchtdak: Right on top of the Mirror Keep, between the mirrors. How did you get up here?
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.chocokelder: Under the hot cocoa café, in a hollow of pink quartz. This is where Mallow keeps his most secret cocoa.
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.galmgrot: In a cave full of singing crystals lies a forgotten chest. It's humming a tune.
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.ijsgrot: Deep in a cave of blue ice lies a forgotten chest of the Crystal Guard!
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.naam.burchtdak: On the Roof of the Mirror Keep
vadsrijk.z2npc.schat.onder_de_brug: A little treasure chest dangles on a string under the western rope bridge. Don't look down!
vadsrijk.z2npc.vrij.z2_versteend_ijsje: Hee hee, it tickled when the crystal broke! I'm going home, to Sugarbowl. Thank you!
vadsrijk.z2npc.vrij.z2_versteend_pluk: My pawsies! I can knit again! The plushies under the ice... they're mine. Will you help them?
vadsrijk.z2npc.vrij.z2_versteend_snoek: I sat still for three days. Best fishing day ever. Nah, just kidding. Thank you so much!
vadsrijk.z2npc.vrij.z2_versteend_zwier: I can twirl again! Look: a spin to the left, a spin to the right... oopsie. Thank you, adventurer!
vadsrijk.z2npc.zone2.klaar: The first splinter of the heart crystal has been found! The Splinter Peaks sing pure and clear again.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.cmd.spawners: %s zone 2 spawners; max alive per area: %s
vadsrijk.z2wezens.mika.paniek.2: Not the mustache! Uh... I don't have a mustache!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.mika.weg.2: I'll be back! With more cheese!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.set.kristal.2: (2) Crystal Skin: +8 Element Resistance, Frozen lasts half as long and heavy hits then do nothing extra
vadsrijk.z2wezens.set.kristal.4: (4) Splinter Strike: 20%% chance that your hit bursts into shards (25%% damage to everything around it)
vadsrijk.z2wezens.set.mika.4: (4) Drill Power: +15%% damage to petrified creatures, +25%% on your first hit
vadsrijk.z2wezens.set.mika.stempel: Stamped: PROPERTY OF NEVERENOUGH. Do not nibble.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.bevroren: You're Frozen: you move slower and a HEAVY hit hurts extra (and breaks the ice). Dodge the big swings!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.galmvleermuis: Gone? Listen! If you hear a high little bell, it's about to pop up behind you.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.ijspuffer: Is it puffing up? Then a freezing cloud is coming. Keep your distance for a bit.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.ijzelgeest: An ice-blue circle under you = the ground freezes there. Step out before you get Frozen.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.kloofgier: Red circle = it's diving. Get out of the circle, and hit it while it sits exhausted on the ground.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.kristalnaaldkruipe: Crystal needles in the snow? One is lying in wait there. Ground shaking: get out of there!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.kristalspin: Her web makes you Sticky. Don't walk through the white sticky spots.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.mika_boorder: The red stripe is where its drill head flies. Step out of the stripe.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.mika_mijnwerker: Running away? Then he's fetching buddies. Finish him before he's back!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.scherfgeest: It flashes around you and then throws shards. Hit it right after its flash.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.schotsbijter: Ice cracking under you? Run! Something's about to bite up through the floe.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.sneeuwknabbelaar: They hunt in packs. See one crouch down low? Then it's about to pounce: step aside.
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.spiegelwacht: Its mirror shield bounces arrows and spells back. Attack it from the side or from behind!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.splinterling: Every hit on a Splinterling shoots shards back at whoever hit it. Hitting from far away doesn't help!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.versteend: This creature has turned to gray crystal. Pink (chonk) does x1.5 damage to it!
vadsrijk.z2wezens.tip.versteende_wacht: Slow but super heavy. Stay out of the red circle, or you'll be dizzy for a bit.
